name: redis-high-evictions
title: A Redis replication group is experiencing unusual key evictions
description: Redis key evictions have remained above the expected anomaly-detection range for 15 minutes. This means that keys are being removed from the cache more frequently than expected, potentially impacting service performance.
investigation_steps: Open the alarm to identify the affected Redis replication group.
Check memory usage, freeable memory, cache demand and the configured eviction policy.
Determine whether cache capacity must be increased or application cache usage has unexpectedly changed.
This could lead to service degradation or unavailability if the high eviction rate persists.
Using breakglass to temporarily increase Redis capacity may be necessary to restore service performance while addressing the underlying issue.
